patterns.title: Clocked register with synchronous reset
patterns.summary: Stores a value on the rising clock edge and clears it synchronously.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        value <= '0;
    end else begin
        value <= next_value;
    end
end

patterns.title: Clocked register with asynchronous reset
patterns.summary: Asserts reset immediately; use only when the target reset strategy requires it.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        value <= '0;
    end else begin
        value <= next_value;
    end
end

patterns.title: Register with clock enable
patterns.summary: Updates a register only when enable is high without creating a gated clock.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        value <= '0;
    end else if (enable) begin
        value <= next_value;
    end
end

patterns.title: Sticky status flag
patterns.summary: Remembers an event until software or control logic explicitly clears it.

patterns.title: Rising-edge detector
patterns.summary: Creates a one-clock pulse when a synchronous signal changes from 0 to 1.

patterns.title: Falling-edge detector
patterns.summary: Creates a one-clock pulse when a synchronous signal changes from 1 to 0.

patterns.title: Toggle register on pulse
patterns.summary: Flips a state bit for each single-cycle event pulse.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        toggle_state <= 1'b0;
    end else if (toggle_pulse) begin
        toggle_state <= ~toggle_state;
    end
end

patterns.title: Parameterized shift register
patterns.summary: Shifts serial data through a configurable-width register; WIDTH must be at least two.

patterns.title: Defaulted combinational logic
patterns.summary: Assigns defaults first so every output is driven on every path.

patterns.title: Two-input multiplexer
patterns.summary: Selects one of two values with a conditional operator.
patterns.code: assign selected_data = select ? data_b : data_a;

patterns.title: Four-input multiplexer
patterns.summary: Uses a complete case statement with a defensive default.

patterns.title: Priority encoder
patterns.summary: Returns the highest-priority asserted request and a valid flag.

patterns.title: Binary-to-one-hot decoder
patterns.summary: Converts a binary index into a one-hot vector.

patterns.title: One-hot-to-binary encoder
patterns.summary: Encodes a one-hot input and reports whether any bit is asserted.

patterns.title: Unsigned minimum and maximum
patterns.summary: Produces the smaller and larger of two unsigned values.

patterns.title: Population count
patterns.summary: Counts how many bits in a vector are high.

patterns.title: Free-running counter
patterns.summary: Increments on every clock and naturally wraps at its maximum value.

patterns.title: Modulo-N counter
patterns.summary: Counts from zero through LIMIT-1 and emits a one-cycle wrap pulse.

patterns.title: Clock-enable pulse divider
patterns.summary: Generates a slow one-cycle enable while keeping all logic on the main clock.

patterns.title: Restartable interval timer
patterns.summary: Starts on command and raises done for one cycle after the selected interval.

patterns.title: Watchdog timeout
patterns.summary: Raises a sticky fault if a periodic service pulse stops arriving.

patterns.title: Pulse stretcher
patterns.summary: Extends a single-cycle event so slower logic can observe it.

patterns.title: PWM generator
patterns.summary: Compares a free-running phase counter with a duty-cycle value.

patterns.title: LED blink divider
patterns.summary: Toggles an LED state after a configurable number of clock cycles.

patterns.title: Event frequency counter
patterns.summary: Counts synchronized event edges during a fixed measurement window.

patterns.title: Programmable rate divider
patterns.summary: Reloads a down-counter to produce a programmable one-cycle tick.

patterns.title: Two-flop bit synchronizer
patterns.summary: Reduces metastability risk for a slowly changing single-bit input.

patterns.title: Asynchronous-assert reset synchronizer
patterns.summary: Asserts reset immediately and releases it synchronously in the destination domain.

patterns.title: Toggle-based pulse synchronizer
patterns.summary: Transfers an occasional pulse between unrelated clock domains using a toggle.

patterns.title: Gray-code counter synchronizer
patterns.summary: Transfers a changing counter safely by synchronizing its Gray-coded representation.

patterns.title: Synchronized edge detector
patterns.summary: Synchronizes an external bit before producing a clean rising-edge pulse.

patterns.title: Counter-based button debouncer
patterns.summary: Accepts a synchronized input change only after it remains stable.

patterns.title: Digital glitch filter
patterns.summary: Changes output only after every sample in a short history agrees.

patterns.title: Source-held multi-bit bus capture
patterns.summary: Use only when the source guarantees the bus remains stable for several destination clocks; otherwise use a handshake or asynchronous FIFO.

patterns.title: Safe finite-state machine
patterns.summary: Uses typed states, a registered state, defaults, and recovery from illegal values.

patterns.title: Moore FSM with registered state
patterns.summary: Derives outputs only from the current state for stable cycle-aligned control.

patterns.title: Mealy FSM output
patterns.summary: Produces an output from both the current state and current input.

patterns.title: One-hot finite-state machine
patterns.summary: Uses one state bit per state for simple decode logic.

patterns.title: Request-acknowledge controller
patterns.summary: Holds a request until acknowledge arrives, then waits for acknowledge to drop.

patterns.title: Two-client round-robin arbiter
patterns.summary: Alternates priority after successful grants so both requesters make progress.

patterns.title: 1011 sequence detector
patterns.summary: Recognizes the serial bit pattern 1011 and allows overlapping matches.

patterns.title: Add-subtract datapath
patterns.summary: Selects addition or subtraction while keeping the result width explicit.

patterns.title: Saturating unsigned adder
patterns.summary: Clamps an overflowing unsigned sum instead of wrapping to zero.

patterns.title: Signed absolute value
patterns.summary: Returns the magnitude of a two's-complement signed input.

patterns.title: Accumulator with clear
patterns.summary: Adds samples into a wider running total under clock-enable control.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset || clear) begin
        accumulator <= '0;
    end else if (sample_valid) begin
        accumulator <= accumulator + sample_value;
    end
end

patterns.title: Power-of-two moving average
patterns.summary: Maintains a running sum so an average needs only subtraction, addition, and a shift.

patterns.title: Barrel shifter
patterns.summary: Performs a variable left or right logical shift in combinational logic.

patterns.title: Leading-zero counter
patterns.summary: Counts zeros from the most-significant bit until the first one.

patterns.title: Fibonacci LFSR
patterns.summary: Generates a repeatable pseudo-random sequence from a nonzero seed.

patterns.title: Ready-valid pipeline register
patterns.summary: Moves one transfer stage while applying backpressure correctly.

patterns.title: One-entry skid buffer
patterns.summary: Temporarily stores one ready-valid transfer when downstream stalls.

patterns.title: UART baud-rate tick
patterns.summary: Creates the clock-enable tick used by a UART transmitter or receiver.

patterns.title: UART receive start detector
patterns.summary: Detects a falling edge on an already synchronized UART receive input.

patterns.title: SPI mode-0 shift register
patterns.summary: Samples MISO and advances MOSI in the SPI clock domain; synchronize completed data before another domain uses it.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge spi_clk) begin
    if (!chip_select_n) begin
        rx_shift <= {rx_shift[6:0], miso};
    end
end

always_ff @(negedge spi_clk) begin
    if (!chip_select_n) begin
        tx_shift <= {tx_shift[6:0], 1'b0};
    end
end

assign mosi = tx_shift[7];

patterns.title: I2C open-drain output
patterns.summary: Drives an I2C line low or releases it; the board must provide the required pull-up.
patterns.code:
assign sda = drive_sda_low ? 1'b0 : 1'bz;
assign sampled_sda = sda;

patterns.title: Memory-mapped register write
patterns.summary: Updates a control register when write-enable and its address match.
patterns.code:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        control_register <= RESET_VALUE;
    end else if (write_enable && address == CONTROL_ADDRESS) begin
        control_register <= write_data;
    end
end

patterns.title: Interrupt event latch
patterns.summary: Keeps an interrupt pending until it is acknowledged.

patterns.title: Synchronous single-port RAM
patterns.summary: Infers a RAM with synchronous write and registered read data.

patterns.title: Simple dual-port RAM
patterns.summary: Uses independent synchronous ports; verify same-address read/write behavior for the target memory primitive.

patterns.title: Case-statement ROM
patterns.summary: Describes a small constant lookup table with a complete default.

patterns.title: Initialized ROM array
patterns.summary: Loads constant contents from a hex file; confirm memory-file synthesis support in the target toolchain.

patterns.title: Synchronous FIFO core
patterns.summary: Implements single-clock FIFO storage with guarded operations and explicit pointer wrapping.

patterns.title: Circular-buffer pointer
patterns.summary: Wraps a pointer explicitly for depths that are not powers of two.

patterns.title: Tapped delay line
patterns.summary: Delays a data word by a fixed number of enabled clock cycles.

patterns.title: Testbench clock generator
patterns.summary: Generates a periodic testbench clock; never place delay controls in synthesizable RTL.
patterns.code:
logic clk = 1'b0;
always #(CLOCK_PERIOD_NS / 2.0) clk = ~clk;

patterns.title: Testbench reset sequence
patterns.summary: Applies reset for several rising edges before starting stimulus.

patterns.title: Immediate simulation assertion
patterns.summary: Stops a simulation immediately when an observed value is wrong.

patterns.title: Concurrent property assertion
patterns.summary: Checks on every clock that a request receives an acknowledge within four cycles.

patterns.title: Simulation timeout guard
patterns.summary: Prevents a broken testbench from running forever.

patterns.title: Wait for clock cycles
patterns.summary: Advances a testbench by an exact number of synchronous cycles.
patterns.code: repeat (CYCLE_COUNT) @(posedge clk);

patterns.title: Reusable pulse task
patterns.summary: Drives a clean one-cycle input pulse from a testbench.

patterns.title: Deterministic randomized stimulus
patterns.summary: Applies bounded pseudo-random inputs while retaining a repeatable seed.
